integrity: The infinite theorem is proved structurally. Exhaustive computation through order 9 is used only as a finite cross-check. General strong-resolving-graph and distance-hereditary results are distinguished from the new chain-specific formula and basis classification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite connected chain graphs and treats strong metric bases, not all strong resolving sets.
The complete-bipartite scalar specialization is prior-covered and is not claimed as new.
Older literature indexed only under Ferrers or difference-graph terminology remains a residual originality risk.
title: Strong metric bases of chain graphs from the canonical cut
